_about: Raised variation (List 35, #337): the general engine the owner's Chao-variation direction required. An individual's presentation DRIFTS across its life as a read over its raising facts (#338's closed set) — derived at read time like #243's stage and #202's mood; there is NO form field on #80's record. #293's alignment-form is one input channel of this engine, not a rival; #329 (care-shaped evolution branches) owns evolution destinations and reads care facts itself — drift is not its input.

closedList: posture & bearing (openness/readiness/ease — read through #152's stocked loops)
proportion emphasis (within #80 size_class bounds — never size, never silhouette; vocabulary is #341's)
palette warmth (render parameter at the colourway's margins, #243's cry-colour class; Lustre Law fence — never a recolour, never an identity colour)
surface & wear (finish of a lived life — biography, not damage; damage is #287's and ordinary raising never reaches it)
channels.schemaFence: the drift read has NO field capable of naming a battle stat, a body part, a posture class, or an eye construction — out-of-envelope outputs are unrepresentable, not merely discouraged

compositionOrder: settled drift facts (resolved at growth moments via #293's mechanism — MUST reproduce, #196)

envelopeTest.oneSpecies: model sheet still governs: no silhouette change, no part added/removed, no posture-class change, no eye-construction change — and NOTHING a #318 register entry could describe (the register's entry form is the negative space of the drift vocabulary)
envelopeTest.twoLives: two individuals of one species with materially different raising histories must be distinguishable at sight, in a still, by a viewer who knows the species — drift too subtle to pass is noise, not variation

growth.accrual: from the first raising facts; small but readable early; grows with the life
growth.settling: at growth moments (#199 evolution, #243 stage boundaries) the settled portion resolves via #293's mechanism; the next growth moment RE-settles from the facts as they then stand — settled is not frozen, so a changed life can change looks across a boundary (recovery is allowed to show; #288 purification is the extreme case and stays #288's)

neverDoes: move any battle number (#293 line: base + #80 variance + #39 effort + #178 growth)
choose an evolution destination (#329's layer, reading care facts itself)
create an obedience/bond/outcome effect (only #180's declared rows do that)
apply to a trait named in a #80 deviations[] entry — RULED deviations bind as exclusions over the whole stack; drift walks around ruled traits, even in the opposite direction
whoHasDrift: every individual with raising facts (kept, Garden, NPC, cast); wild individuals read from encounter-generated facts (#243/#214 family — a wild life is a raising too); zero facts read as zero drift, which is a reading, not a missing value
